---
name: Work order
about: A small, explicit unit of work with acceptance criteria
title: "[area] concise outcome"
---

**Goal**
What must be true when this issue is complete?

**Context**
Relevant ADRs, schemas, design notes.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Functional behaviour
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Error/failure handling
- [ ] Security considerations
- [ ] Logs/metrics where relevant
- [ ] Documentation updated

**Out of scope**
Explicitly excluded work.

**Owner**
One developer / AIOS.

**Dependencies**
Other issues / contracts.
